messages:
marta: FYI i opened a PR to tighten SOC2-friendly wording around audit log retention and legal holds. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/358. need legal + security eyes on the exact phrasing and an example export snippet.

kevin: quick scan — auditors want an explicit statement that retention is only extended for lawful process. suggest: 'We suspend retention only when preservation is required by lawful process (e.g., court order, subpoena).'

oliver: +1. also prefer 'suspend retention' instead of 'suspend deletion'. less confusing for customers.

legal: that sentence works. please also add: 'Customers will be notified of holds affecting their data where permitted by law.' keeps transparency for SOC2 reviewers.

marta: added both lines. drafting a compact curl + expected-response snippet for exported redacted audit logs. PTAL: ```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"from":"2025-08-01T00:00:00Z","to":"2025-08-31T23:59:59Z","redaction":"pii_removal"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/exports
```

kevin: include expected async response example and note artifacts are available 7 days by default. e.g. `{ "job_id": "exp_abc", "status": "queued", "download_url": null, "expires_at": null }`

marta: added response and 7-day note. also added a tiny glossary: pii_removal = remove common PII fields, summary = redact non-actionable details, none = raw export (enterprise-only).

docs-bot: updated PR description with final wording and snippets. CI queued.

legal: approved the phrasing for SOC2 evidence. please copy the exact sentence into the evidence pack for auditors.

marta: saved sentence to evidence/docs/soc2-evidence.md and linked it in the PR. merging after CI passes. closing thread :white_check_mark:
